title: User addresses
description: Manage user shipping and billing addresses.
catalogDescription: Every shipping and billing address in the company.

help.title: About Customer addresses
help.overview: Customer addresses are the saved billing and shipping addresses of shop customers. Buyers manage their own from their account; this page lets staff see and maintain every customer's addresses.

sections.title: Fields
items: Customer and type (billing or shipping) are required.
First and last name, street, city, country, and map coordinates are required; email, phone, state, postal code, and a label are optional.
Country, state, and postal code are what tax zones and shipping zones match against at checkout.

sections.title: Default addresses
sections.body: Each customer has at most one default address per type.
items: Set default, or saving an address as default, clears the previous default of the same type for that customer.
Checkout and the customer's account offer the default first.

sections.title: Two views of the same records
items: From Configurations, every customer's addresses are listed and a new one asks which customer it belongs to.
In the customer's own account, only their addresses are listed and new ones are filed under them.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
